description: This file contains multiple class definitions for different variations of a log consistent grain used in testing various storage providers and configurations within an Orleans-based project. It includes classes for Azure storage, memory storage, custom storage, and primary cluster storage, implementing interfaces for custom storage operations.

classes.name: LogTestGrainSharedStateStorage
classes.description: A grain class configured to use Azure storage with a specific state storage provider.

classes.name: LogTestGrainSharedLogStorage
classes.description: A grain class configured to use Azure storage with a log storage provider.

classes.name: LogTestGrainDefaultStorage
classes.description: A grain class that uses the default storage provider.

classes.name: LogTestGrainMemoryStorage
classes.description: A grain class configured to use MemoryStore for storage.

classes.name: LogTestGrainCustomStorage
classes.description: A grain class implementing custom storage interface with explicit storage logic and external grain interaction.

classes.name: LogTestGrainCustomStoragePrimaryCluster
classes.description: A grain class implementing custom storage with in-memory state, designed for primary cluster access, including simulated async activation.

methods.name: GetStorageGrain
methods.description: Retrieves the grain used as the primary storage grain for custom storage operations.

methods.name: ApplyUpdatesToStorage
methods.description: Applies a list of updates to the storage, returning success status.

methods.name: ReadStateFromStorage
methods.description: Reads the current state from storage, returning a key-value pair of version and state.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Simulates asynchronous activation, including a delay to test for deadlocks.

methods.name: TransitionState
methods.description: Transitions the grain state based on an update, used internally.
